an6.64:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chayimāni bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭipānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
an6.64:1.3: idha bhikkhave tathāgato ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an6.64:1.4: yampi bhikkhave tathāgato ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idampi bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, pariyāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. (2)
an6.64:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an6.64:2.2: yampi bhikkhave tathāgato atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idampi bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabala hoti, yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. (3)
an6.64:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an6.64:3.2: yampi bhikkhave tathāgato jhānavimokkhasamādhiyamāpattinaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idampi bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. (4)
an6.64:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ, dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an6.64:4.2: yampi bhikkhave tathāgato anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbe nivāsaṃ anussarati, idampi bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsahaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. (5)
an6.64:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti,
an6.64:5.2: yampi bhikkhave tathāgato dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti, idampi bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. (6)
an6.64:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an6.64:6.2: yampi bhikkhave tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, idampi bhikkhave tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
an6.64:6.3: imāni kho bhikkhave cha tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni, yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
an6.64:7.1: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanti,
an6.64:7.2: yathā yathā bhikkhave tathāgatassa ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ viditaṃ, tathā tathā tesaṃ tathāgato ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti.
an6.64:8.1: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanti,
an6.64:8.2: yathā yathā bhikkhave tathāgatassa atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ viditaṃ, tathā tathā tesaṃ tathāgato atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti.
an6.64:9.1: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesā vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanti,
an6.64:9.2: yathā yathā bhikkhave tathāgatassa jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ viditaṃ, tathā tathā tesaṃ tathāgato jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti.
an6.64:10.1: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ pubbenivāsānussatiṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanti,
an6.64:10.2: yathā yathā bhikkhave tathāgatassa pubbenivāsānussatiṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena viditaṃ, tathā tathā tesaṃ tathāgato pubbenivāsānussatiṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena pañhaṃ puṭṭho vyākaroti.
an6.64:11.1: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanti,
an6.64:11.2: yathā yathā bhikkhave tathāgatassa sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ viditaṃ, tathā tathā tesaṃ tathāgato sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti.
an6.64:12.1: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ āsavānaṃ khayā yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanti,
an6.64:12.2: yathā yathā bhikkhave tathāgatassa āsavānaṃ khayā yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ viditaṃ, tathā tathā tesaṃ tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇena pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti.
an6.64:13.1: tatra bhikkhave yamidaṃ ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tampi samāhitassa vadāmi, no asamāhitassa.
an6.64:13.2: yampidaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tampi samāhitassa vadāmi. no asamāhitassa.
an6.64:13.3: yampidaṃ jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tampi samāhitassa vadāmi. no asamāhitassa.
an6.64:13.4: yampidaṃ pubbenivāsānussatiṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tampi samāhitassa vadāmi, no asamāhitassa.
an6.64:13.5: yampidaṃ sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tampi samāhitassa vadāmi. no asamāhitassa.
an6.64:13.6: yampidaṃ āsavānaṃ khayā yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tampi samāhitassa vadāmi. no asamāhitassa.
an6.64:13.7: iti kho bhikkhave samādhi maggo, asamādhi kummaggoti.
an6.64:14.1: soṇo phagguṇaṃ chaḷābhijātiyo āsavā dārukammahatthimajjhaṃ passa cittaparāyanaṃ udakaṃ nibbedhikasīhanādena vaggoti – sīmu soṇo phagguṇobhijāti
